name: Optimize Adobe
description: Kills Creative Cloud processes, disables services, blocks GCClient, and to reduce background resource usage
commands:
# Run in 64-bit PowerShell as Administrator
 
 # --- kill known Adobe executables ---
 $images = @(
  'Adobe CEF Helper.exe','FlashPlayer_ActiveX.exe','Creative Cloud Helper.exe',
  'Adobe Media Encoder.exe','Adobe Premiere Pro.exe','Adobe XD.exe','Adobe Fuse.exe',
  'Adobe Media Encoder CC.exe','ae_renderer.exe','AdobeIPCBroker.exe'
 )
 
 $extra = @(
  'AdobeIPCBroker.exe','AAMUpdater.exe','AMS.exe','Typekit.exe','AdobeCrashDaemon.exe',
  'TeamProjectsLocalHub.exe','dynamiclinkmanager.exe','PhotoshopElements.exe',
  'Dreamweaver.exe','AdobeSpark.exe','CharacterAnimator.exe','LightroomClassic.exe',
  'Prelude.exe','Muse.exe','Captivate.exe','SpeedGrade.exe','Scout.exe','ScoutCPP.exe',
  'BridgeCC.exe','CameraRaw.exe','AdobeCreativeCloudCleanerTool.exe','Lightroom.exe',
  'InDesign.exe','Audition.exe','Bridge.exe','PhotoshopLauncher.exe','Illustrator.exe',
  'FlashPlayerPlugin.exe','AcroRd32.exe','Acrobat.exe','Animate.exe','CCXProcess.exe',
  'Adobe Desktop Service.exe','AdobeUpdateService.exe','AdobeExtensionsService.exe',
  'CoreSync.exe','acrotray.exe','AdobeARM.exe','AcrobatNotificationClient.exe',
  'CCLibrary.exe','AdobeCollabSync.exe','AdobeDesktopService.exe','Photoshop.exe',
  'AfterFX.exe'
 )
 
 foreach($exe in ($images + $extra) | Select-Object -Unique){
  $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($exe)
  Get-Process -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 }
 
 # --- stop services ---
 foreach($svc in 'AGSService','AdobeUpdateService','AGMService','AdobeARMservice'){
  $s = Get-Service $svc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if($s){ if($s.Status -eq 'Running'){ Stop-Service $svc -Force } Set-Service $svc -StartupType Disabled }
 }
 
 Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
 
 # --- harden AdobeGCClient folder ---
 $gc = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Adobe\AdobeGCClient'
 if(Test-Path $gc){ Remove-Item $gc -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
 New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $gc -Force 
 icacls $gc /deny "$env:USERNAME":D 
 icacls $gc /deny "$env:USERNAME":R 
 icacls $gc /deny "$env:USERNAME":W 
 
 # --- kill AGS/AGM executables if still present ---
 foreach($exe in 'AGSService.exe','AGMService.exe'){
  $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($exe)
  Get-Process -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 }
 
 # --- take ownership, grant admins, then rename ADS binary ---
 $ads = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Adobe\Adobe Desktop Common\ADS\Adobe Desktop Service.exe'
 if(Test-Path $ads){
  takeown /f "$ads" 
  icacls "$ads" /grant Administrators:F 
  Rename-Item -Path "$ads" -NewName 'Adobe Desktop Service.exe.old' -Force
 }
